name: 11552 · W Hempstead, NY
findings: ZIP 11552 (W Hempstead) has 116 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11552 (W Hempstead) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11552 (W Hempstead) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
